attacks.claim: The QA table reports the staff pilot (64 staff cards, real holds) as completed with 0 misdelivered texts and 2 copy fixes. The rollout schedules that pilot for Nov 2-6, and today is 2026-10-26. The result cannot exist yet, so the evidence is premature or unsupported. It is also the only evidence of real-world delivery, because the other QA ran against the SMS provider in test mode.
attacks.evidence: | Staff pilot week (64 staff cards, real holds) | 0 misdelivered texts; 2 copy fixes shipped and re-verified | vs. "1. Nov 2-6: flags on for staff cards only (pilot above)."

attacks.claim: The fixed announcement text says alerts are for every cardholder, but juvenile cards never see the SMS option. Guardians can opt in only with their own number on the linked guardian account, so the public copy overstates availability.
attacks.evidence: "Text alerts for holds, for every cardholder." vs "juvenile cards do not show it"

attacks.claim: Message and routing behaviour is under-specified for batched holds and for STOP. A batched text for holds with different locker banks or codes is not defined. A patron who chose SMS instead of email and then sends STOP has no stated fallback channel.
attacks.evidence: "extra holds are batched into one message"; "in addition to (or instead of) the current email"; STOP "clears the opt-in flag"

attacks.claim: Flags go on for all cardholders at 09:00, but the live smoke test that gates the announcement runs afterward, so opt-in is live before the smoke test confirms it works. Locker banks can also be offline for up to a 4 h vendor SLA with no compensating notice to patrons who already hold codes.
attacks.evidence: "Nov 9 09:00: flags on for all cardholders; announcement goes out at 10:00 only after a smoke test"; "vendor SLA 4 h on-site"
